'''Faddaff Davenspon''' was a [[Deymasollian]] [[Gender|female]] who, after a life of tinkering and [[Standard year|years]] of interstellar travel, had top-notch technical skills and an innate feel for [[starship]] systems. She worked as an outlaw [[Technician|tech-for-hire]] but would never settle for a routine job and was willing to cut a deal to get hold of technology that intrigued her.

She had lived on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]] for several years before the [[First Order]] occupied it, and in [[35 ABY]], she spent [[time]] in the bar of the [[Spice Runners' Den]] in [[Kijimi City]] shortly before the [[Sith Eternal]] [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] it.

==Biography==
[[File:Faddaff_Davenspon_TROS.png|thumb|left|200px|Davenspon spent time in the Spice Runners' Den.]]
Faddaff Davespon was a [[Deymasollian]] [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Djin" /> [[Reproduction|born]] around [[265 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> who survived<ref name="Djin" /> during her long, well-traveled life by working as an outlaw [[Technician|tech-for-hire]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> for the highest bidder.<ref name="Djin" /> For many [[winter]]s, she lived on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]],<ref name="TROS VD" /> and she had been there for several [[Standard year|years]] before it was occupied by the [[First Order]].<ref name="Djin" /> During the occupation<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> she was standing with two hooded figures in the bar of the [[Spice Runners' Den]] in [[Kijimi City]] when the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi|Spice Runner]] [[Zorii Bliss]] led a group of [[Resistance]] agents through the room. Not long after the encounter,<ref name="TROS" /> the First Order [[Protocol 13|evacuated]] all of their [[First Order military|forces]] from the world<ref name="TROS VD" /> before it was [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] by the [[Sith Eternal]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:FaddaffDavenspon-Encyclopedia.png|thumb|right|250px|Faddaff Davenspon was a skilled outlaw tech-for-hire.]]
Faddaff Davenspon was willing to cut a deal<ref name="TROS VD" /> and lower her rates<ref name="Djin" /> to get her [[Limb|hands]] on technology that intrigued or excited her. This was especially true of [[starship]] designs that she had not previously encountered in her long and well-traveled life.<ref name="TROS VD" />

Like all Deymasollians, Davenspon had a keen memory and would never have settled for a routine job. She had [[Color|yellow]] skin, black [[eye]]s, and a white [[Hair|fur]] coat that had grown thicker over her many winters on Kijimi. The Deymasollian's delicate fingers were well-scaled for fine technological work.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Skills and abilities==
After a lifetime of tinkering with everything she could get her hands on, Faddaff Davenspon had developed top-notch technical abilities. As a result of years of experience with interstellar travel,<ref name="Djin" /> she had an innate feel for starship systems<ref name="TROS VD" /> that made her particularly good at working on them.<ref name="Djin" />

==Equipment==
Davenspon wore a black [[Clothing|outfit]] with [[boot]]s and [[glove]]s and had three grease tanks attached to her chest. She used a pair of gray [[goggles]] with yellow lenses.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_16.png|thumb|right|200px|"Wizard 16" by Louis Wiltshire]]
Faddaff Davenspon was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> She was identified simultaneously in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]],<ref name="TROS VD" /> and a card in the ''[[2019 Topps Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Series 1]]'' trading card set by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]].<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Series 1|cardname=Faddaff Davenspon|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/211130/cid/13996010/2019-Topps-Star-Wars:-The-Rise-of-Skywalker-29-Faddaff-Davenspon}}</ref>

Concept art of Davenspon titled "Wizard 16" was created for the film by creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Louis Wiltshire]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> Creature and droid puppeteer [[Barbara Fadden]]<ref name="TROS" /> portrayed Davenspon, [[Odla Sur]], and [[Fadda-Rarb Arda]] in the film.<ref name="Fadden">{{WebCite|url=https://www.barbarafadden.com|text=Barbara Fadden – Creature Performer|author=Fadden, Barbara|archivedate=20220404171843}}</ref> Footage of Davenspon standing on the street outside the door to the Spice Runner's Den while watching Bliss and the Resistance group enter was also shot but not used in the final cut of the film.<ref name="Legacy">{{Film|IX}} "The Skywalker Legacy" featurette</ref>

Concept art of the streets of Kijimi City produced by senior concept artist [[Tony Tran]] for the [[2024]] [[Massive Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' included Davenspon with other characters<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=tonytran|url=artwork/RKKZBm|name=[[Tony Tran]]|text=''Star Wars Outlaws'' - Kijimi City Streets|date=2024-10-11}}</ref> that appeared on Kijimi in Episode IX.<ref name="TROS" /> None of these characters were used in the final release of the game.<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>
